infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nourishare uses the camera so you can photograph a dish when logging a recipe, for example taking a picture of tonight's pasta to attach to your meal log.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nourishare uses your photo library so you can choose meal and profile photos, for example attaching a saved picture of a dish to a recipe log.
